sloka: ते बद्धघण्टाबलिनो घोररूपा निशाचराः ।विगर्जमानाः संहृष्टा धूम्राक्षं पर्यवारयन् ।विविधायुधहस्ताश्च शूलमुद्गरपाणयः ।। ६.५१.२३ ।।।।
transliteration: te baddhaghaṇṭābalino ghorarūpā niśācarāḥ ।vigarjamānāḥ saṁhṛṣṭā dhūmrākṣaṁ paryavārayan ।vividhāyudhahastāśca śūlamudgarapāṇayaḥ ।। 6.51.23 ।।।।

translations.english: On hearing the words of Dhumraksha, the CommanderinChief of the large army, he got ready quickly by the order of Ravana.
